'''Joel Daniel Freeland''' (born 7 February 1987) is a British former professional [[basketball]] player who last played for [[PBC CSKA Moscow|CSKA Moscow]] of the [[VTB United League]]. Standing at {{height|m=2.10}},<ref>[http://www.cskabasket.com/team/?player=2494&team=main&season=79&lang=en Joel Freeland #19 Height: 210 cm Weight: 112 kg.]</ref> he played at the [[Power forward (basketball)|power forward]] and [[Center (basketball)|center]] positions. He also represented the [[Great Britain national basketball team]].

==Professional career==

===Early years===
Freeland began his career as a youth player with the youth teams of Thames Valley Tigers/Guildford Heat, before joining the Solent Stars. Within a year, he was representing England's Under-18 national team, and soon found himself in Spain, with the [[Liga EBA|fourth division]] side Gran Canaria II. While playing in the lower level Spanish leagues, Freeland was drafted by the [[Portland Trail Blazers]], becoming the 30th overall pick of the [[2006 NBA draft]], which was the highest rank for a British born player in the history of the draft.<ref>[http://www.getsurrey.co.uk/sport/other-sport/basketball/joel-freeland-recalls-farnham-roots-4807958 Joel Freeland recalls Farnham roots on NBA debut.]</ref> The Blazers encouraged Freeland to remain in Europe to learn his trade, and he subsequently signed with [[CB Gran Canaria|Gran Canaria]], of the [[Spanish basketball league system|Spanish top-tier level]] [[Liga ACB]] in August 2006.<ref>[http://archivo.marca.com/edicion/marca/305/nba/es/desarrollo/678618.html Freeman jugará en la ACB con el Gran Canaria Grupo Dunas {{in lang|es}}.]</ref>

During the 2006–07 season, while playing with Gran Canaria, Freeland appeared in 16 games in the Liga ACB, and also made his debut in the [[European professional club basketball system|European-wide 2nd-tier level]] [[ULEB Cup]] (now called [[EuroCup Basketball|EuroCup]]). Freeland continued to improve during the 2007–08 season, appearing in 28 games in the Liga ACB, and reaching the quarter-finals of the ULEB Cup. The 2008–09 season saw Freeland become one of Gran Canaria's best players, as he averaged 9.9 points and 4.8 rebounds per game, in 17.8 minutes per game in the Liga ACB.<ref>[http://www.draftexpress.com/profile/Joel-Freeland-1055/stats/ JOEL FREELAND Basic Statistics.]</ref>

===Unicaja Malaga===
In July 2009, Freeland joined the Spanish [[EuroLeague]] club [[Baloncesto Málaga|Unicaja Málaga]], on a five-year contract worth [[Euro|€]]4.5 million euros [[net income]].<ref>[http://www.euroleague.net/news/i/55325/unicaja-bulks-up-with-joel-freeland Unicaja bulks up with Joel Freeland],</ref> During the 2009–10 season, Freeland made his debut in [[European professional club basketball system|Europe's top-tier level league]], the [[EuroLeague]], and also made 37 [[Spanish ACB League]] appearances. The 2010–11 season was Freeland's best season, as he averaged career-highs of 13.2 points and 6.2 rebounds per game in the Liga ACB,<ref>[http://www.draftexpress.com/profile/Joel-Freeland-1055/stats/ JOEL FREELAND Basic Statistics.]</ref> and 13.9 points and 6.3 rebounds per game in the EuroLeague.<ref>[http://www.euroleague.net/competition/players/showplayer?pcode=LOO&seasoncode=E2010 FREELAND, JOEL EuroLeague 2010-11 STATISTICS.]</ref>

In July 2012, Freeland reached an agreement with Unicaja on a €1.5 million buyout.<ref>[http://www.sportando.com/en/usa/nba/93357/joel-freeland-heading-to-the-blazers.html Joel Freeland heading to the Blazers]</ref>

===Portland Trail Blazers===
On 28 June 2006, he was selected by the [[Portland Trail Blazers]] in the first round of the [[2006 NBA draft]] as the 30th overall draft pick. However, the Trail Blazers encouraged him to return to European play to further improve his game. On 13 July 2012, Freeland signed a three-year deal with the [[Portland Trail Blazers]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.iamatrailblazersfan.com/PressReleaseDisplay/tabid/297/itemId/3175/Default.aspx|title=TRAIL BLAZERS SIGN BRITISH FORWARD JOEL FREELAND|work=NBA.com|date=13 July 2012|access-date=15 July 2012|url-status=usurped|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120715213903/http://www.iamatrailblazersfan.com/PressReleaseDisplay/tabid/297/itemId/3175/Default.aspx|archive-date=15 July 2012}}</ref> On 14 December 2012, he was assigned to the [[Idaho Stampede]] of the [[NBA D-League]].<ref>[http://www.nba.com/dleague/idaho/claver_freeland_assigned_1213_2012_12_14.html CLAVER, FREELAND ASSIGNED TO STAMPEDE] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150629231139/http://www.nba.com/dleague/idaho/claver_freeland_assigned_1213_2012_12_14.html |date=29 June 2015 }}</ref> He was recalled on 16 December 2012.<ref>[http://basketball.realgm.com/wiretap/225050/Blazers-Recall-Claver-Freeland Blazers Recall Claver, Freeland]</ref>

On 26 December 2014, Freeland recorded a career-high 17 rebounds against the [[Philadelphia 76ers]]. On 13 April 2015, he scored a career-high 16 points against the [[Oklahoma City Thunder]].<ref>[https://www.basketball-reference.com/players/f/freeljo01/gamelog/2015/ Joel Freeland 2014-15 Game Log]</ref>

===CSKA Moscow===
On 13 July 2015, Freeland signed a two-year contract with the Russian club [[PBC CSKA Moscow|CSKA Moscow]].<ref>{{cite news|title=CSKA returns Joel Freeland back to Europe|url=http://www.cskabasket.com/news/?id=14473&lang=en|access-date=13 July 2015|work=cskabasket.com|date=13 July 2015|archive-date=13 July 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150713181341/http://www.cskabasket.com/news/?id=14473&lang=en|url-status=dead}}</ref> In a warm-up for a preseason game against [[Galatasaray S.K. (men's basketball)|Galatasaray]], he suffered a left [[Calf (anatomy)|calf]] injury, which prevented him from play at the start of the season.<ref>{{cite news|title=CSKA Moscow's Joel Freeland will miss the beginning of the season|url=http://www.sportando.com/en/europe/russia/177394/cska-moscow-s-joel-freeland-will-miss-the-beginning-of-the-season.html|access-date=30 September 2015|work=sportando.com|date=30 September 2015}}</ref> During his two-year stint with CSKA, he won the [[EuroLeague]] in [[2015–16 Euroleague|2016]] and was a two time [[VTB United League]] champion ([[2015–16 VTB United League|2016]], [[2016–17 VTB United League|2017]]). Following the expiration of his contract, he left the club at the end of the 2016–17 season.<ref>{{cite news|title=Thank you, Joel!|url=http://www.cskabasket.com/news/?id=16125&lang=en|access-date=18 June 2017|work=cskabasket.com|date=17 June 2017}}</ref>

==International==
Freeland represented the senior [[Great Britain national basketball team]] at the [[EuroBasket 2009]] and the [[EuroBasket 2011]]. He also played at the [[Basketball at the 2012 Summer Olympics – Men's tournament|2012 Summer Olympics]].<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20110812095407/http://archive.fiba.com/pages/eng/fa/p/rpp/q/Joel%20Freeland/pid/_/players.html Joel FREELAND (ENG) participated in 8 FIBA / FIBA Zones events.]</ref>
